lines.text: Jehoram son of Ahab becomes king of Israel, removes Baal's pillar, yet clings to the sins of Jeroboam.
After Ahab dies, Mesha of Moab rebels, so Jehoram asks Jehoshaphat of Judah to fight Moab, and he agrees.
The three kings go by the Desert of Zin, run out of water, and Jehoshaphat asks for a prophet, Elisha.
Elisha asks for a harpist, tells them to dig ditches, and the next morning water flows from the direction of Edom.
The Moabites mistake the water for blood and flee from Israel, and after the king of Moab burns his son, Israel stays and captures Kir-haraseth.

wrong_details.true: Israel withdraws and returns to their own land
